text:
Alice W.: quick customer ask — Cust 'Bluewave' wants to fastpath nyx-10b-variant into Redwood Hosted for eval -> latency/cost targets + HIPAA
Raj P.: what's the priority? do they need private or hosted?
Alice W.: hosted first, P2. they want smoke perf within 48h and quant experiment results within a week. sample traffic: 80% chat short (<=128 tokens), 20% long (>=1024).
Morgan H.: got it. likely candidate for q4_0 or q8_0 quant. we'll need generation quality regression tests vs fp16 baseline.
Samira K.: can we reuse the "customer-smoke" eval set + our toxicity/regression suite? also need acceptance criteria (latency p95 < 200ms on dGPU pool, cost < $0.002/token est)
Alice W.: yes reuse customer-smoke. acceptance criteria noted.
Raj P.: I'll kick off a compatibility run on dev-gpu1 tonight. Plan:
```
# run compatibility smoke
run_onboard --model nyx-10b-variant --mode smoke --dataset customer-smoke --batch 1 --seq 128
# quant experiment
run_quant --model nyx-10b-variant --schemes q4_0 q8_0 --eval customer-smoke --save artifacts/nyx10b_quant
```
Morgan H.: quick notes:
- enable KV cache inspect for long sequences
- capture logits and response diffs for the regression suite
- compare sampling seeds 42, 43
Raj P.: will capture seeds + logs. target: perf + quality matrix.
onboard-bot: Checklist created: [compatibility smoke, quant experiments, perf bench, eval regression, canary deploy]. ETA fields: smoke (48h), quant (7d)
Samira K.: assign owners: Raj -> smoke + quant run; Morgan -> eval/regression analysis; Alice -> customer comms + rollout gating
Alice W.: pinging infra for temporary dev-gpu quota bump for 48h @eng-infra
Raj P.: small gotcha: nyx-10b uses custom rotary enc config — I will add a conversion patch if needed.
Morgan H.: if quantized logits drift > 1e-2 on mean L2 relative to fp16, flag as quality regression and hold canary.
Samira K.: also run the semantic similarity eval (BLEU/ROUGE not enough) — use our embedding-based similarity on the anchor set.
Alice W.: noted. I'll update the onboarding ticket with these acceptance criteria and owners.
Raj P.: starting runs now, will post artifacts link when done. :rocket:
Morgan H.: thanks — once artifacts are in, I'll run the regression notebook and post summary table.
Alice W.: thanks team. I'll let the customer know timeline (smoke results in ~24-36h). :thumbsup:
